        y = x1
        return gcd, x, y

        if gcd != 1:
            return None
        return (x % m + m) % m

    x = remainders[0]
    M = moduli[0]
    
    for i in range(1, len(remainders)):
        a1, m1 = x, M
        a2, m2 = remainders[i], moduli[i]

        inv = mod_inverse(m1 % m2, m2)

        x = a1 + m1 * k
        M = m1 * m2
        x = x % M
    
    return float(x)
